body:
Correction to release 20261029T093937Z-Nadia-742043a8: the suite totals were overstated.

Authoritative (sequential per-batch runs): backend 3717 passed / 4 skipped, with 23 failures confined to tests/tools — 22 are documented Windows-baseline entries and test_stop_already_stopped passes in isolation (batch-order flake). Not 3722 passed / 2 skipped.

Cause: a full ci-check.sh run that outlived its 600 s command ceiling overlapped the sequential batches, so its counts (which included 51 errors) are not a valid signal. Everything else in the release stands (commit 9bfe6fd2, live wire proof PASS, three prior harnesses PASS).
